title: compilation
description: One compilation's record (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 118): research/paper/compilations/<name>/compilation.json, written only by wayline.compilations through the ledger, `plain` at every paper order and a venue's slug for a venue. The paper's version it typeset, each of the four outputs (and a BibTeX venue's .bib) with its file or why it was not made, the class and the CSL style it used, the citations as code planned them, the scout's last retry at the order, the venue's checks on the compiled output, the fitting session when the paper exceeded a limit, and any tag text found in an output, which must be none.

name.description: plain, or the venue's slug: the directory under compilations/

outcome.description: compiled when all four outputs were made and no tag text survived

document_class.description: the LaTeX class: the venue's where one is vendored, article otherwise

csl.description: the venue's CSL style under guidelines/<venue>/, null for pandoc's default

bibtex.description: a BibTeX venue: the LaTeX cites through natbib and references.bib is written

pages.description: the compiled PDF's page count as pdfinfo read it

main_pages.description: the page the main text ends on, before the front statements, the references, and the supplement: what a venue's page limit is checked against

tools.description: the version of each tool called, from tools.json

cited.description: the slugs of the works cited, in first-citation order

to_be_resolved.description: unresolved works whose claims are kept marked "to be resolved", never cited

retried.description: the paper order's last retry of the unresolved cited works; null for a compilation alone

checks.description: the venue's checks on the compiled output, after the fitting when there was one; empty for plain

fitting.description: the one fitting session, when the paper exceeded a limit

still_over.description: the limits the fitted paper still exceeds

tag_text.description: tags found written in an output: none in a compilation
